There aren't 'too many' games on Steam

I'm not so sure about this. TotalBiscuit did an excellent piece last year about the lack of quality control Steam suffers from. It's sad to say that, ultimately, he was proven right, as nothing has gotten better since that video.

One of the best things about Steam is that small scale developers do have a chance to get their product out there and share it with the masses. That's great, it truly is. But when other developers take advantage of this privilege and use Steam as a medium to further their garbage game or use Early Access as a cash cow, then that's when the system starts to fail.

I wouldn't say Steam has "too many" games. No, what I'd say is Greenlight and Early Access are broken systems. They are way too easily manipulated and corrupted by developers who see gamers as consumers and not, well gamers.
